name: Twin Echo
source:
“The greatest crime is sometimes not an act, but the indifference that lets a person wither away in loneliness.”

You step into the shoes of Jocelyn, a young woman haunted by the mysterious death of her twin sibling.

Every choice you make, every word you speak, even a moment of silence, can create an echo that lasts forever – shaping the fate of Jocelyn and those around her.

Will you break the silence, or become part of that terrifying indifference?
